preparedAccounts.note: Both roles and both members were kept (not deleted). The G14-Viewer member was completed through the real signup + invite flow so the read-only UI checks used a genuinely signed-in read-only member, not a minted token.

VAL-CROSS-002.observed: Role G14-Host created from the Host preset (D1 grants: read:reservation:any + update:reservation:any only). Member host_cross_g14 (rsv-g14-1@example.com) invited by email with that role, completed signup and is an active acme member. As that member: the Reservations sidebar group renders Today, Book and Waitlist (no Settings, Guests, Experiences, Reports links). Today renders bookings; a phone booking for 2026-10-27, party 2, phone +15555551401 succeeded (POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations -> 201) and appears in the day list; the Arrived and Seated quick actions each returned 200 and the tenant DB row is status='seated'. Refusals: typed URLs /acme/reservations/settings, /guests and /reports each returned document 403 with a '403 Forbidden: requires ...' page (not a rendered screen); token mints /acme/reservations/token?scope=setup|guests|reports|payments each returned 403 (book returned 200); with the member's book token, GET /operator/reservations/setup/locations/<downtown>/settings -> 403 and GET /operator/reservations/guests?q=a -> 403 while GET /operator/reservations/book/day (Downtown, 2026-10-27) -> 200.
VAL-CROSS-002.notes: Discrepancy to flag (not silently resolved): the contract journey says the sidebar 'shows only Today and Book', but the implementation also renders a Waitlist entry for this role. The entry is governed by sections.ts (waitlist requires read:reservation:any + the reservations.waitlist flag) and by architecture.md ('each link filtered by sections.ts requirements'); nav.test.ts asserts waitlist:true for read+update reservation members. Waitlist is a booking-surface link, not one of the forbidden setup/guest/report/payment surfaces, and the assertion's fail criteria ('any forbidden screen renders, any refused mint returns a token, or any refused tenant-api call returns 2xx') are all satisfied. The sidebar link set was exactly [/acme/reservations/today, /acme/reservations/book, /acme/reservations/waitlist]. The contract's 'Upcoming tab' wording: the booking appeared in the Today day list for its date (2026-10-27) after the POST 201; by the time it was seated it no longer appears under an Upcoming filter, so the 'appears in Upcoming' checkpoint was satisfied as 'appears in the day feed', not re-verified under the Upcoming filter chip. Console errors: none captured in either browser session.

VAL-CROSS-003.observed: As kody, Settings -> Members -> 'Staff locations' for Host Cross G14 was set to 'Selected locations' with only Downtown Flagship checked; local D1 shows UserOrganization.locationScope='selected' for rsv-g14-1@example.com. As the member: the location picker no longer lists Waterfront (with a single accessible location the picker is hidden entirely; the page text contains neither 'Downtown' nor 'Waterfront'), and /acme/reservations/book?location=vw6s16lrjjvyafd3dc4cqexu renders no Waterfront data - the page's day request is book/day?locationId=v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8 (forced back to Downtown). The member's freshly minted book token decodes to locationIds=['v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8'] (exactly Downtown), grants [read:reservation:any, update:reservation:any]. With that token: GET book/day Waterfront -> 403 {"error":"location_forbidden","message":"Location is outside your assigned scope"}; GET book/day Downtown -> 200; POST book/reservations for Waterfront -> 403 location_forbidden.
VAL-CROSS-003.notes: Picker wording: the contract expects the picker to list only Downtown; the implementation hides the picker when the member can see exactly one location, so the excluded location is invisible rather than shown-and-filtered. Waterfront name/slots/rows never reached the member's browser or curl. No console errors.

VAL-BOOK-032.observed: Used a real signed-in read-only member: viewer_g14 (rsv-g14-2@example.com), role G14-Viewer (read:reservation:any only), completed through the invite + signup flow. Today (/acme/reservations/today) renders (booking row with running timer) with no New Reservation, Walk-in, Arrived or Seat controls; Book (/acme/reservations/book) renders with list filter chips only (All/Upcoming/Arrived/Seated/Completed/Unassigned/Conflicts/No-Show/Cancelled) and no New Reservation/Walk-in; the detail sheet /acme/reservations/book?r=rsv_1b4eebe2-a6bd-4b14-9819-227259e7dccd renders read-only with Close as its only button. The member's book token decodes to grants ['read:reservation:any'] and every mutating endpoint returned 403 insufficient_permissions required update:reservation:any: POST /book/reservations, PATCH /book/reservations/:id, POST /book/reservations/:id/status, POST /book/reservations/:id/undo, POST /book/walk-ins.
VAL-BOOK-032.notes: No console errors. The viewer can still see reservation rows and the read-only detail sheet (guest phone shown there); guest-PII redaction rules beyond VAL-HOST-023 were out of scope for this group.

VAL-SETUP-027.observed: Minted a setup-scope token narrowed to read:reservation_settings:any (decoded claims: scope 'setup', grants ['read:reservation_settings:any'], no update grant, not impersonated). All 24 setup GET routes tried returned 200 (overview, locations/:id/settings, settings, locations/:id/floor-plan, locations/:id/areas, tables, locations/:id/tables, combos, locations/:id/combinations, elements, services, locations/:id/services, turn-times, locations/:id/turn-times, pacing, locations/:id/pacing, service-availability, special-days, locations/:id/special-days, blocks, locations/:id/validation, locations/:id/conflicts, locations/:id/sections, sections/layouts). Writes with the same token were refused: PUT /locations/:id/settings -> 403, PUT /locations/:id/floor-plan -> 403, POST /services -> 403, each body {"error":"insufficient_permissions","required":"update:reservation_settings:any"}. Negative control: GET settings with no Authorization header -> 401.
VAL-SETUP-027.notes: Contract says the refusal is '403 forbidden'; the observed status is 403 and the body is insufficient_permissions with the required grant - the contract's evidence line asks for 403, which is met. The assertion's UI half (save/create controls disabled or hidden on /acme/reservations/settings* for a read-only setup operator) was not exercised: this group has no setup-only signed-in member, and the assertion's tool/evidence contract is curl + tenant-api tests. The App token route refuses to mint a setup token for operators without settings or reservation-read grants (verified for the Host member in VAL-CROSS-002).

VAL-HOST-023.observed: Created booking rsv_c557ea1f-347d-4b9f-90b5-ad4d9c311988 for 2026-10-27 20:00, party 2, Downtown, via the operator API with guest.allergyNotes='contract-allergy-host023'; the tenant DB statement recorded was SELECT id, first_name, last_name, phone_e164, allergy_notes FROM rsv_guests WHERE allergy_notes IS NOT NULL AND allergy_notes != ''; -> gst_44bec57e-808b-4c3e-acc4-a1088206c581|G14 Allergy|Host023|+15555551403|contract-allergy-host023. GET /operator/reservations/book/overview?locationId=<downtown>&date=2026-10-27 as kody (book token carrying canReadGuest, so tenant-api grants read:reservation_guest:any) -> 200 with allergyList[0].allergyNotes='contract-allergy-host023' (literal present) and the Overview UI shows '20:00 - G14 Allergy Host023 (2) contract-allergy-host023'. The same request as the Host member (host_cross_g14, no guest grant) -> 200 with allergyList[0]={hasAllergy:true, dietaryNotes:null, allergyNotes:null} and the literal absent from the JSON; the Overview UI shows 'Dietary / Allergies 1' and 'Dietary / allergy flag on file (restricted detail)' with no raw text.
VAL-HOST-023.notes: Kody half proven by the API response (literal present) and the UI screenshot; Host half proven by both the API response (literal absent, hasAllergy flag true) and the UI screenshot (restricted-detail flag). No console errors.

VAL-HOST-025.observed: Read-only operator viewer_g14 (read:reservation:any only): POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations/:id/assign -> 403, PUT /operator/reservations/book/service-notes -> 403, PUT /operator/reservations/book/sections/assignments -> 403 (each insufficient_permissions required update:reservation:any). A book-scope token with update:reservation:any but no settings grants: POST /operator/reservations/setup/sections/layouts -> 403 invalid_scope (expected setup, actual book). UI: /acme/reservations/timeline renders the table rows with 0 draggable bars and no assign controls; /acme/reservations/floor renders the floor plan (table shapes, Available) with 0 draggables and no New Reservation/Walk-in controls.
VAL-HOST-025.notes: Timeline and Floor still render their static drag-hint copy ('Drag bars to reassign...') for the read-only operator, but no element is draggable (document.querySelectorAll('[draggable=true]') = 0) and no assign/seat controls exist, so the surfaces are read-only. The sections/layouts refusal is a scope refusal (book token) rather than a grant refusal; a setup-scope token without the update grant is also refused (see VAL-SETUP-027). No console errors.

friction.description: The documented recipe to complete signup from D1 does not work as written: the Verification table has no 'code' column (it stores a TOTP secret/period/algorithm/charSet), and the App cannot send signup emails in Workers dev (POST /signup.data -> 500 'API key is invalid' from the real Resend call), so the invite email/code never arrives.
friction.resolution: After the failed signup POST created/updated the Verification row, computed the current onboarding TOTP locally with @epic-web/totp generateTOTP({secret, period, digits, algorithm, charSet}) read from local D1, then completed /verify + /onboarding normally. Values were never written to evidence; the temp files holding them were deleted.

friction.description: The Settings -> Members 'Create Link' invite link always creates the built-in Member role (createOrganizationInviteLink hardcodes roleId 'org_role_member'), so the invite-link path cannot produce the Host-preset member the contract describes.
friction.resolution: Used the email-invitation form instead (role dropdown on the invite row), which sets the invitation's organizationRoleId, then completed signup from the invitation token read out of D1 OrganizationInvitation.

friction.description: First load of /acme/settings/members and /signup rendered without React interactivity (clicks did nothing, no popups opened); the members-page role DropdownMenu and member-row Selects only opened after a reload.
friction.resolution: Reloaded the route once the first compile finished (documented 30-66 s first-load behavior), after which the dropdowns and handlers worked. Some submissions were completed with form.requestSubmit() instead of the covered ref click.

friction.description: The Today-page Arrived/Seat quick actions were covered by a sticky element for agent-browser ref clicks ('Element is covered by <p.text-muted-foreground.m-0>').
friction.resolution: Clicked the row-scoped button with an in-page JS click (runtime-findings pattern); both requests returned 200.

friction.description: On /signup the first <form> in the DOM belongs to the 'Signup with GitHub' button; a naive form.requestSubmit() triggered a GitHub OAuth redirect to /onboarding/github.
friction.resolution: Selected the form containing the email input and submitted that one.

friction.description: Contract-vs-implementation mismatch: VAL-CROSS-002's journey says the Host sidebar shows 'only Today and Book', but the shipped sidebar also renders Waitlist for that role (sections.ts gives the waitlist link the same read:reservation:any requirement, matching architecture.md and nav.test.ts).
friction.resolution: Reported as-is; not resolved by redefining the pass. The assertion's explicit fail criteria (forbidden screen renders / refused mint returns a token / refused tenant-api call returns 2xx) are all unmet, so it is marked pass with this deviation called out for the parent validator.

summary: All six assigned assertions pass. Created the G14-Host (Host preset: read+update reservation only) and G14-Viewer (read only) roles plus two real members (host_cross_g14, viewer_g14) through the email-invite + signup flow. VAL-CROSS-002: the Host member booked/arrived/seated a phone booking for 2026-10-27 and was refused setup, guests, reports and payments at typed URLs (403), token mints (403) and tenant-api (403). VAL-CROSS-003: scoping the member to Downtown hid Waterfront everywhere (token locationIds exactly Downtown; Waterfront day feed and POST 403; typed Waterfront URL forced back to Downtown). VAL-BOOK-032/VAL-HOST-025: a genuinely signed-in read-only member renders Today/Book/detail/Timeline/Floor read-only with no mutating controls, and all eight mutating book endpoints plus the section-layout setup write return 403. VAL-SETUP-027: a read-only setup token gets 200 on all 24 setup GETs tried and 403 on PUT settings/floor-plan and POST services. VAL-HOST-023: kody's overview shows 'contract-allergy-host023' (API + UI) while the Host operator's overview shows only a redacted allergy flag and the literal is absent from both the API JSON and the DOM. One contract-vs-implementation deviation flagged: the Host sidebar also lists Waitlist.
